The '''Sickle-back Mantis''', or '''Sickle-back Mantis of Dantooine''', was a type of mantis native to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. After mating, the [[Gender/Legends|female]] would rip off the male's head and deposit her [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] in his body. The offspring would then emerge, consume the carcass, and fight. Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] showed a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of these creatures to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
